metadata.description: Tools from Future Practice Studio, installable as Claude Code plugins. Each tool holds mechanism and defaults; your settings live in your own project.

plugins.name: prospector
plugins.description: Finds companies whose recent events make them live prospects, from your own ideal-customer triggers, and routes results to the surface you name. Placeholder release: the setup and collection skills land in 1.0.0.

plugins.name: edition-cover
plugins.description: Makes the cover image for a newsletter edition or LinkedIn article from its number, title and subtitle, in your project's own colors, fonts and wording.
